notes.title: Diverse Accidents and Collisions Await You
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, rescuers![/h1]
Today, we’re giving you a glimpse into the variety of accidents and collisions you'll encounter in Accident. From everyday mishaps to dramatic disasters, each scenario challenges you to think quickly and act decisively to save lives. Here's a preview of some of the incidents you'll face:
[h2]Diverse Accident Scenarios[/h2]
[b]Car Off the Road:[/b] Picture a car that loses control and veers off the road, tumbling down a steep hillside. Your quick response is crucial to rescue the passengers from this chaotic situation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/62a573b479d8d8d3648920f7b3db39a6e4573d7a.gif[/img]
[b]Pedestrian Collision:[/b] Imagine a bustling intersection where two cars collide, sending one vehicle skidding into a pedestrian crossing the street. You must assess the scene swiftly and provide aid to both the drivers and the injured pedestrian.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/5e9e22e77f44c47f36f231dada43bd693bb1af43.gif[/img]
[b]Truck and Wild Animal:[/b] A high-speed encounter with a wild animal can lead to disaster. What happens when a driver swerves to avoid a deer, only to crash into an oncoming truck? The scene is chaotic, with multiple victims needing immediate attention.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/8211e14503e0f0ed64dc0b0c1029c96f731ced81.gif[/img]
[b]Railroad Crossing Disaster:[/b] A moment's distraction at a railroad crossing can have catastrophic consequences. When a driver fails to notice an approaching train, the collision leaves a trail of destruction, and it's up to you to manage the aftermath.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/2d517d4bac18e66beaa7315db097ab292f8719fb.gif[/img]
[h2]Prepare for the Unexpected[/h2]
Each accident scenario in Accident is designed to test your abilities and decision-making skills in high-stress situations. No two accidents are the same, so you'll need to adapt to the unique challenges of each scene.
Thank You and Stay Tuned!
We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all our fans for your support and enthusiasm. Don't forget to check out the Gas Station Simulator Universe for more incredible games and big discounts. 
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35934053/sale/GasStationSimulator3rdAnniversary
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35934053/sale/GasStationSimulator3rdAnniversary][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/66f4dc8a2da08d97143bd1645d510a47ae711ab4.jpg[/img][/url]


Stay tuned for more updates, and remember, every second counts when saving lives!

notes.title: Exploring Accident's Diverse Locations
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Rescuers![/h1]

Today, we’re thrilled to take you on a virtual tour of some of the remarkable locations you’ll encounter while investigating road accidents in our game, Accident. From the serene Italian Alps to the bustling streets of American cities, Accident offers a wide variety of environments that not only challenge your skills but also provide a unique and immersive experience. Let's dive into these exciting locations!

[h2]Italian Alps: Serenity Meets Danger[/h2]
Our journey begins in the breathtaking Italian Alps. This picturesque location, with its towering mountains and winding roads, is a sight to behold. However, its beauty is matched by the danger of navigating these treacherous roads. Sharp turns, and steep cliffs make every investigation here a thrilling challenge. Your quick thinking and precision are crucial to save lives and uncover the truth behind each accident.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/e49d720b46fd0c074634f8a05811c6ea83cf6e02.gif[/img]

[h2]Russian Tundra: Cold and Isolated[/h2]
Next, we travel to the frosty expanses of the Russian Tundra. This harsh, snowy landscape presents unique challenges with its icy roads and remote locations. The isolation and extreme cold mean that every second counts when responding to an accident. The stark beauty of the tundra hides numerous perils, making your job even more critical.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/cbc9e827511116fce4908e7ae220a2ccf381ab57.gif[/img]

[h2]American Cities: Urban Chaos[/h2]
From the remote wilderness, we move to the bustling, chaotic streets of American cities.  Navigating through the urban jungle requires keen observation and quick reflexes to manage the scene and ensure everyone's safety.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/d3a82b8d3e9b2d17a3d2795f544e18deddf74015.gif[/img]
And Many More...

Accident’s world is vast and varied, with many more unique locations waiting to be explored. Each environment offers distinct challenges and surprises, ensuring that no two investigations are ever the same.

This is just a glimpse of the diverse settings you’ll experience in Accident. Each location is meticulously designed to provide a realistic and engaging backdrop for your investigations. We can’t wait for you to explore these places and uncover the stories behind each accident.

[b]Before we sign off, we have some exciting news! Our talented colleagues have just released a teaser for Car Dealer Simulator. Check it out on the game's Steam page and get a sneak peek at what’s coming next![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

Stay safe and happy investigating!

The Accident Team

notes.title: Unveiling the World of Rescues in "Accident" 🚑🚨
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rescue Enthusiasts!

We're back with exciting news and a fresh look into the immersive world of "Accident." For those who haven't joined the ranks of accident investigators and first responders yet, now's the perfect time to get a glimpse of the heart-pounding action and life-saving decisions that await you in our game.

[b]1. Investigate Car Accidents:[/b]
As a dedicated journalist, you'll step into the shoes of an accident investigator. Your mission? Unravel the mysteries of car accidents. Collect evidence, reconstruct events, and uncover the truth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/98722491e89a6f4e95621e5a6cf3b6f0e492fcca.gif[/img]
[b]2. Assess the Victims:[/b]
Every second counts when it comes to saving lives. Check the condition of the victims—Are they still breathing? Have they sustained serious injuries? Your decisions on providing first aid, stopping bleeding, checking pulses, and positioning the injured can make all the difference.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/eae647ac5701c05fa66de203c9fdcc9ec81a174f.gif[/img]
[b]3. Make Critical Decisions:[/b]
Who should receive help first? How can you best assist them? Be cautious, as improper assistance may jeopardize lives, and time is of the essence. Think on your feet, but remember, the clock is ticking!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/fa68195c7b9b114b1c4c8f3ff57d59fedc2d721d.gif[/img]
[b]4. Time Reversal Mechanism:[/b]
Did you make a mistake? Couldn't save everyone in time? Fear not! Utilize the unique time reversal feature and give it another shot. Learn from your experiences and fine-tune your life-saving skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/ebfac49e914059726c5ca2cc3df36a613f0e8b3b.gif[/img]

[b]Special Promotion Alert! 🌟[/b]
In celebration of the adrenaline-pumping world of "Accident," we're thrilled to announce a special promotion starting today! Dive into the gripping experience, make split-second decisions, and become the hero the victims need.

Bundle Bonanza! 🚁🚗
But wait, there's more! Coinciding with the launch of promotion "Accident," we're introducing an exclusive bundle featuring both "Accident" and its adrenaline-packed counterpart, "Plane Accident." Don't miss this opportunity to grab two thrilling titles in one package.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38868/Accident_franchise_bundle/

Get Ready for the Rescue Mission! 🏥🔍
"Accident" offers a unique blend of excitement and responsibility, putting you at the forefront of life-saving decisions. Grab your copy today, and remember, every second matters!

Thank you for being a part of our rescue journey!

notes.title: Accident is full-released now with a 30% launch discount!
notes.notes:
Accident has officially become a full-released game. We have already shared a major update, so if you have Accident it will be transformed into the full-released game and if you don’t have it yet, it is a great opportunity to buy it with a [b]30% launch discount[/b]. We also invite you to join us on a Developers' Stream, which is on our Steam Page.

With the full release update, we give you a whole [b]new scenario[/b] taking place in the Czech Republic, as well as special [b]video cut-scenes[/b] showing the course of each accident, with which all the previous maps have been enriched. They will add a lot of immersion, because now you’ll be able to actually see what happened, instead of imagining it basing on the clues. You will also see how little it takes to bring about a dangerous incident on the road.

[previewyoutube=-ZeihmzqUSQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We are not forgetting about bugs - the full release update contains a lot of bug fixes to the previous maps, making the game a better product.

Last, but not least, Accident gets the Turkish language, which has been asked for a long time.

We hope you will enjoy playing and re-playing the new Accident, so we wish you a lot of fun!

notes.title: Accident coming out of Early Access
notes.notes:
Finally, Accident is coming out of Early Access and becoming a full-released game. This shift will take place on Tuesday, September 21. All of you, who already have the game, will get a major update and if you don’t have Accident yet, it will be a great opportunity to buy it.

With the full release update, you will get a whole new scenario taking place in the Czech Republic, as well as individual film recordings showing the course of each accident, with which all the previous maps have been enriched. They will add a lot of immersion, because now you’ll be able to actually see what happened, instead of imagining it basing on the clues.

[previewyoutube=-ZeihmzqUSQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We are not forgetting about bugs - the full release update will contain a lot of bug fixes to the previous maps, making them better places.

Last, but not least, Accident will also get the Turkish language, which has been asked for a long time now.

We hope you will enjoy playing and re-playing the new Accident, as we have been working a lot on delivering you the full release.

notes.title: Steam Autumn Festival: Accident
notes.notes:
Find out, what happened!

Become an investigative journalist who uses modern technology to recreate past road accidents. 

[list]
[*] Secure the site, help the victims and gather clues to find out, what has really happened before the calamity
[*] Use your skills to perform CPR and give first-aid to the victims in need
[*] Decide, who to help first and beat the clock before the victims die
[*] Analyze clues, make the puzzles complete and solve the mysteries to gain access to more complicated cases
[/list]  

Accident is a puzzle game packed with action and detective work. Besides pure fun, it also has a strong educational factor - you will learn, how to act in case of a road emergency and what to do, to secure yourself and those in need. If you like simulation games and you want to learn something new about first-aid response and preserving safety during road accidents, you definitely have to try out Accident!
